chunks: We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Yahya al-‘Attar, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, that he said: I was told by Ahmad ibn Sahl al-Azdi al-‘Abid, that he said: I heard Abu Farwa al-Ansari, and he was one of the travelers, saying:

Isa ibn Maryam said: O assembly of disciples, by the truth I am saying to you: Indeed, the people are saying that a construction is (standing) by its foundation, and I will not say that to you. They said: Then what do you say, O Spirit of Allah? He said: By truth I am saying to you: Indeed, the last stone placed by the labourer is the foundation.
Abu Farwa said: He only indicated the seal of the matter.
ai.seo_question: What does Jesus mean when he says the last stone is the foundation?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this saying of Isa (AS) to highlight the Shia principle that the finality of a matter validates its entirety, a concept often applied to the Ahl al-Bayt as the 'seal' of prophethood and divine guidance. Abu Farwa’s interpretation underscores that the concluding element serves as the definitive proof of the preceding work's authenticity, mirroring the theological view that the Imams complete and confirm the message of the Prophet. This metaphor reinforces the importance of continuity and the culminating authority in establishing religious truth.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Yahya al-‘Attar, that he said: We were told by Muhammed ibn Hussain, that he said: I was told by Ahmad bin Sahl al-Azdi al-‘Abid, that he said: I heard Abu Farwa al-Ansari, and he was one who used to journey, say:

Isa ibn Maryam said: O assembly of disciples, by the truth I am saying to you: Indeed, the people are saying that a construction is (standing) by its foundation, and I will not say that to you. They said: Then what do you say, O Spirit of Allah? He said: By truth I am saying to you: Indeed, the last stone placed by the labourer is the foundation.»
Abu Farwa said: He only indicated the seal of the matter.
